title: Diagram Archetype Registry Entry
description: Validates one diagram archetype registry entry (database/diagrams/<id>.json): a named, parameterized diagram type with a deterministic SVG renderer. Generated questions reference these by archetypeId and supply typed parameters.

subjectsApplicable.description: Subject codes whose questions may use this diagram, e.g. ['SAT_MATH']

paramsSchema.description: An EMBEDDED draft-07 JSON Schema (itself with type: 'object') describing the typed parameters a question supplies for this diagram. Draft-07 cannot express 'this value is itself a valid schema', so full validity of paramsSchema is enforced by a dedicated validator script, not by this file.

rendererRef.description: Name of the deterministic SVG renderer component, PascalCase, e.g. 'GraphLine'
